spans.s:
√dīkṣ 'be consecrated'
present: [1.] dīkṣate etc. B.+ 
perfect: didīkṣé etc. didīkṣus 
aorist: [3.] adidīkṣas -- [5.] adīkṣiṣṭa etc. 
future: [1.] dīkṣiṣyáte etc. B.+ -- [2.] dīkṣitā 
verbal: dīkṣitá AV.+ dīkṣitvā́ -dīkṣya 
secondary: desiderative: didīkṣiṣate etc. -- causative: dīkṣayati etc. B.+ dīkṣayate dīkṣāpaya 
derivatives: dīkṣā́ AV.+ dīkṣaka C. dīkṣaṇa S.+ dīkṣayitṛ B. 
BR. suggest a derivation from √dakṣ.
